map.计算需求价格弹性，评估价格变动对销量的影响: Compute demand price elasticity and assess how a price change affects volume
map.📖 查看「价格弹性计算器 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Price Elasticity Calculator User Guide"
map.需求价格弹性（Price Elasticity of Demand, PED）衡: Price elasticity of demand (PED) measures how sensitive demand is to a price change. High elasticity means price moves volume a lot; low elasticity means it moves volume little.
map.需求量变动% = (新销量 - 原销量) ÷ 原销量 × 100%: Change in demand % = (new volume - original volume) / original volume × 100%
map.价格变动% = (新价 - 原价) ÷ 原价 × 100%: Change in price % = (new price - original price) / original price × 100%
map.：价格变动不影响销量: : price changes do not affect volume
map.：价格与销量变动比例相同: : price and volume change in the same proportion
map.：价格变动对销量影响大（奢侈品）: : price changes move volume a lot (luxuries)
map.：微小价格变动导致销量剧变: : a tiny price change causes a huge volume swing
map.富有弹性商品：降价可增加总收入（薄利多销）: Elastic goods: cutting price raises total revenue (thin margin, high volume)
map.缺乏弹性商品：提价可增加总收入（刚需品）: Inelastic goods: raising price raises total revenue (necessities)
map.单位弹性：价格变动不影响总收入: Unit elastic: price changes leave total revenue unchanged
map.：必需品弹性小，奢侈品弹性大: : necessities are inelastic and luxuries elastic
map.：占收入比例越高，弹性越大: : a bigger share of income means higher elasticity
map.涨价前量化销量会掉多少，判断总收入涨跌。: Before a price increase, quantify how far volume falls and whether total revenue rises or drops.
map.按 |E| 分完全无弹性/缺乏/单位/富有弹性。: Classify by |E| as perfectly inelastic / inelastic / unit / elastic.
map.对比促销前后收入变化选策略。: Compare revenue before and after a promotion to choose the strategy.
map.会。短期刚性、长期可替代则变弹；促销期与平时也不同，宜分场景测算。: It does. Demand is rigid in the short run but becomes elastic as substitutes appear over time; promotion periods differ from normal periods, so measure by scenario.
map.价格弹性计算器。营销分析工具，帮助量化评估营销效果与 ROI。: Price elasticity calculator. A marketing analytics tool for quantifying campaign performance and ROI.
map.结果区的「价格变动 / 销量变动」仍按相对期初的简单百分比显示：(新值 − 旧值: The price change and volume change in the results still use the simple percentage versus the starting point: (new − old) ÷ old × 100%.
map.例如：价格从100降到90，销量从1000升到1200；按中点法 销量变动≈+1: For example, price falls from 100 to 90 and volume rises from 1000 to 1200; with the midpoint method volume changes by about +18.2% and price by about −10.5%, so elasticity ≈ −1.73.
map.价格 100→110（+10%）、销量 1000→850（−15%）→ 中点法: Price 100 to 110 (+10%) with volume 1000 to 850 (−15%) gives a midpoint elasticity of about −1.70, so |E|>1 and demand is elastic; revenue falls from 100000 to 93500, so the price rise loses money.
map.价格 100→110、销量 1000→970（−3%）→ 中点法 E≈−0.32: Price 100 to 110 with volume 1000 to 970 (−3%) gives a midpoint elasticity of about −0.32, so demand is inelastic; revenue rises from 100000 to 106700 (110×970), so necessities suit a price rise.
map.正常，价量反向；看绝对值。|E|<1 缺乏弹性可提价增收，|E|>1 富有弹性提: Yes, price and volume move in opposite directions; look at the absolute value. |E|<1 is inelastic and a price rise can raise revenue, while |E|>1 is elastic and a price rise tends to lose revenue; this page computes elasticity with the midpoint method.
map.新旧价格相同，价格变动为 0，无法计算需求价格弹性。请调整新价后再算。: The new price equals the old price, so the price change is 0 and demand elasticity cannot be computed. Change the new price and try again.
map.公式：价格弹性 = 销量变动% ÷ 价格变动%（弧弹性，中点法）: Formula: price elasticity = volume change % ÷ price change % (arc elasticity, midpoint method)
map.降价带来收入增加（薄利多销有效）: Price cut raises revenue (thin margin, high volume works)
map.提价且收入增加（需求刚性，可继续观察）: Price rise also raises revenue (rigid demand, keep watching)
map.提价导致收入减少（价格敏感，慎用提价）: Price rise cuts revenue (price sensitive, avoid raising price)
map.降价仍使收入减少（降价无效，需查成本与需求）: Price cut still cuts revenue (ineffective, check cost and demand)
map.收入持平，价格变动未改变总收入: Revenue unchanged, the price move did not change total revenue
map.本次调价使总收入上升，可小范围延续并继续观察销量与毛利；若为降价，注意毛利率是否: This price move raised total revenue, so continue on a small scale while watching volume and margin; with a price cut, check that gross margin remains acceptable.
map.本次调价使总收入下降，建议回退价格或先做小范围测试，再结合成本与需求弹性调整，不: This price move lowered total revenue; revert it or run a small test first, then adjust using cost and demand elasticity rather than rolling out at full scale.
map.本次调价后总收入持平，价格变动对收入影响有限，应更多关注成本控制与产品差异化。: Total revenue is unchanged, so price has limited revenue impact; focus more on cost control and differentiation.
